metadata.question: Does forest cover in the Madre de Dios region of Peru decrease in 2018 compared to 2013?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Madre de Dios region, Peru, from FAO/GAUL/2015 level1 boundaries.
- Data: UMD/Hansen Global Forest Change 2021 v1_9 (global, includes loss years through 2021). We compare 2013 vs 2018 using lossyear codes.
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- No cloud masking needed; use Hansen static product. Forest defined as treecover2000 ≥ 30%, and not lost by end of target year.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check region feature count; if 0 -> D.
- Compute base pixel count at 1 km; if 0 -> C2.
- Check area values for null/NaN -> C3.
- If both valid, compare 2018 < 2013 -> A else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(eeObject) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    eeObject.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

function fmt(n, digits = 2) {
  if (n === null || n === undefined || isNaN(n)) return String(n);
  return Number(n).toFixed(digits);
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const country = 'Peru';
    const regionName = 'Madre de Dios';
    const scale = 1000; // use >=1000m per best practices
    const thr = 30; // tree canopy cover threshold (%)
    const yearA = 2013;
    const yearB = 2018;

    // Region: FAO/GAUL level1 (departments/regions)
    const gaul1 = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', country))
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', regionName));

    const regCount = await getInfoAsync(gaul1.size());
    if (!regCount || regCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Region features: ${regCount}`);
      console.log('Region not found in GAUL.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }
    const region = ee.Feature(gaul1.first()).geometry();
    const regionAreaKm2 = ee.Number(region.area({maxError: 1, proj: ee.Projection('EPSG:4326')})).divide(1e6);
    const regionAreaKm2Val = await getInfoAsync(regionAreaKm2);

    // 2. Data Acquisition (Hansen GFC)
    // Use 2021 v1_9 (well-known ID) which covers 2013 and 2018.
    const gfc = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2021_v1_9');
    const treecover = gfc.select('treecover2000');     // percent 0-100
    const lossyear = gfc.select('lossyear');           // 0 (no loss) or 1..21 => 2001..2021

    // Validate base pixels (to detect C2)
    const basePixCount = ee.Image(1).rename('ones').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('ones');
    const basePixCountVal = await getInfoAsync(basePixCount);
    if (!basePixCountVal || basePixCountVal === 0) {
      console.log(`Region features: ${regCount}; Area km2: ${fmt(regionAreaKm2Val)}`);
      console.log(`Base pixels (1km): ${basePixCountVal}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Forest definition for a given year: tc>=thr AND (lossyear=0 OR lossyear > y-2000)
    function forestMaskForYear(y) {
      const cutoff = ee.Number(y).subtract(2000);
      const base = treecover.gte(thr);
      const notLostByY = lossyear.eq(0).or(lossyear.gt(cutoff));
      return base.and(notLostByY);
    }

    function areaAndCountForYear(y) {
      const fmask = forestMaskForYear(y);
      const areaKm2Img = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6).updateMask(fmask);
      const areaKm2 = areaKm2Img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('area');
      const forestPixCount = ee.Image(1).rename('ones').updateMask(fmask).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('ones');
      return { areaKm2, forestPixCount };
    }

    const a = areaAndCountForYear(yearA);
    const b = areaAndCountForYear(yearB);

    const areaA = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(a.areaKm2));
    const areaB = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(b.areaKm2));
    const pixA = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(a.forestPixCount));
    const pixB = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(b.forestPixCount));

    // 3. Validation & Calculation
    if (
      areaA === null || areaB === null ||
      isNaN(areaA) || isNaN(areaB)
    ) {
      console.log(`Region features: ${regCount}; Area km2: ${fmt(regionAreaKm2Val)}`);
      console.log(`Hansen loaded. Threshold: ${thr}%`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = areaB - areaA;
    const pct = (areaA !== 0) ? (diff / areaA) * 100.0 : null;

    // 4. Concise Evidence
    console.log(`Region features: ${regCount}; Area km2: ${fmt(regionAreaKm2Val)}`);
    console.log(`Hansen v1_9 loaded. Threshold: ${thr}%`);
    console.log(`Base pixels (1km): ${basePixCountVal}`);
    console.log(`${yearA} Forest km2: ${fmt(areaA)}; Pixels: ${pixA}`);
    console.log(`${yearB} Forest km2: ${fmt(areaB)}; Pixels: ${pixB}`);
    console.log(`Change km2: ${fmt(diff)}; Percent: ${pct === null ? 'null' : fmt(pct)}%`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (pct === null) {
      console.log('C3');
    } else if (areaB < areaA) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
